svg.title: A graph replay narrows the gap before every kernel
svg.desc: Two timelines of twenty kernels of 2 µs each, drawn to scale from measured averages. Direct launches: the host row shows twenty launch calls of 1.75 µs each, done after 35 µs; on the GPU row every kernel follows a gap of 1.52 µs and the twentieth ends at 70.4 µs. Graph replay: the host row shows one cudaGraphLaunch call of 5.6 µs; on the GPU row the gaps shrink to 0.81 µs and the twentieth kernel ends at 56.2 µs.
svg.text: A graph replay narrows the gap before every kernel
graphs.cu averages on the author's GTX 1650 (7.5), CUDA 12.3, October 2026; to scale, not a trace.
